theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_density_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (A V : Set (Eucl P)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen V → A ⊆ V → (∀ x ∈ A, t ≤ dimensionalUpperDensity ν.toOuterMeasure (n : ℝ) univ x) → t * (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) A ≤ ν V
